citation.title: Pragmatic generative optimization of novel structural lattice metamaterials with machine learning
citation.authors: Anthony P. Garland; Benjamin C. White; Scott C. Jensen; Brad L. Boyce
citation.version_coded: Version of record abstract; no accessible full text

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: The abstract says the CNN and genetic-algorithm workflow discovers lattice unit cells for competing stiffness and wave-speed objectives using 3500 simulation calls, but it does not establish a classical topology-optimization comparison.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: The abstract reports 3500 simulation calls, not a speed-up or computational-time comparison.
claim.alternatives: The abstract mentions Pareto-optimal unit cells for elastic stiffness and impact wave speed.

baseline.quality_metric: elastic stiffness and wave speed objectives

reporting.n_test_cases: 3500 simulation calls reported; test-case count unclear
